name: Golden Quadrilateral
one_line: A 5,846-kilometre loop of national highways joining Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata

highway.value: NH 48 (Delhi to Mumbai and Chennai), NH 16 (Chennai to Kolkata), NH 19 and NH 44 (Kolkata to Delhi)

source.title: Golden Quadrilateral
Golden Quadrilateral Bike Trip on Royal Enfield | Budget Tips…

fuel.note: Pumps are those drawn on the open map within the search radius of the road. A pump missing from the map is missing here, so each gap is a worst case.

rules.title: Mumbai to Pune Expressway: no two-wheelers
rules.detail: Two-wheelers, three-wheelers and tractors are barred. Riders take the old national highway through Khandala and Lonavala. No government order was found.

source.title: Mumbai–Pune Expressway

rules.title: Delhi to Mumbai Expressway: no two-wheelers
rules.detail: Motorcycles, scooters, three-wheelers and tractors are barred by gazette notice. Riders stay on the old highway through Jaipur.

rules.title: Ahmedabad to Vadodara Expressway: no two-wheelers
rules.detail: Two-wheelers of every kind have been barred since it opened. Riders use the national highway alongside. No government order was found.

source.title: Ahmedabad–Vadodara Expressway
Ahmedabad–Vadodara Expressway

rules.title: Mumbai harbour sea bridge: no two-wheelers
rules.detail: The bridge from Sewri to Navi Mumbai bars two-wheelers and three-wheelers. Riders leave Mumbai by the older roads. No government order was found.

source.title: Mumbai Trans Harbour Link
Mumbai Trans Harbour Link

rules.title: Bengaluru to Chennai Expressway: no two-wheelers
rules.detail: Two-wheelers are barred from the open stretch in Karnataka after a fatal crash. Riders stay on the old national highway.

rules.detail: Motorcycles pass toll plazas on national highways free. The highways authority denied reports in June 2025 that this would end.

rules.title: Delhi: fuel refused to vehicles past age limit
rules.detail: Petrol vehicles over 15 years and diesel over 10 count as end-of-life. Reports opened do not say whether two-wheelers are covered. Carry a valid pollution certificate.

gaps: No government order found for the two-wheeler bans on the Mumbai to Pune Expressway, the Ahmedabad to Vadodara Expressway or the Mumbai sea bridge; the sources are encyclopedia pages.
No source found on whether the two-wheeler ban also covers the Andhra Pradesh stretch of the Bengaluru to Chennai Expressway opened in 2026.
No official page found that settles whether two-wheelers may use the Yamuna Expressway; two pages on one toll guide contradict each other.
No source opened says whether Delhi's age limit for vehicles is applied to motorcycles.
Nothing found for the east coast leg: no rule, season or hazard sourced for Visakhapatnam, Bhubaneswar or Kolkata, including cyclones.
Nothing found for Varanasi, Kanpur, Udaipur or Jaipur.
No source found for the usual number of days riders take; the best months rest on one rider's guide.
No highest point recorded for the loop.
The first video is dated from its title; the second has no known filming date.
